sources.title: GPT-6 Luna Model | OpenAI API
sources.snippet: reasoning.effort supports none, low, medium (default), high, xhigh, and max. Use the Responses API for built-in tools and function calling. Chat Completions supports function calling only with reasoning_effort set to none.

sources.title: GPT-6 Luna - Specs, Benchmarks & Details
sources.snippet: About GPT-6 Luna GPT-6 Luna is the high-efficiency foundation model in OpenAI's GPT-6 lineup designed for low-latency workloads. It is tailored for high-throughput chat, classification, and lightweight agentic applications.
